version.name: Qwen Image 2.1 [V3.0]
version.changelog_html:
• Dropped GGUF support in favor of native Safetensors.

  • Rewrote system prompt to optimize instruction adherence for smaller LLM sizes.

  • Merged V1 (Production) and V2 (Simple) workflows into a single release package.

local_compatibility.static_prompt_mode: supported by the V3 Simple workflow; bypasses prompt enhancer
local_compatibility.adaptation: Use current local Qwen Image 2.1 int8 stack and standard VAE decode unless installing compatible upstream dependencies/models.
